caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object centered on a beige background. The object consists of a loop at the top, which is oval-shaped with slightly irregular and rough contours, and a shank below that tapers into a threaded section resembling a screw. The color of the object is a rusty brown with darker and lighter spots suggesting oxidation and texture. The threaded part shows closely spaced, well-defined ridges that spiral around the shaft, leading to a slightly pointed tip. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition. In the lower right corner, the drawing is signed "Eugene Bartz 1939" in handwritten text.
title: Shroud Deck Eye
